faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)
faq.subtitle: Here are answers to common questions asked by parents and educators using DOOLIA.
faq.q1_title: Q1. Are all coloring pages really 100% free?
faq.q1_desc: Yes! All DOOLIA coloring pages can be freely printed and downloaded anytime without sign-up or payment.
faq.q2_title: Q2. Can I use these in classrooms, kindergartens, and schools?
faq.q2_desc: Absolutely! You can freely print and use them for any non-commercial educational purposes in homes, kindergartens, schools, and daycare centers. (Commercial resale and redistribution of the files are strictly prohibited.)
faq.q3_title: Q3. How do I get the best print quality on my printer?
faq.q3_desc: Simply click the [Print] button on the details page, and margins are automatically optimized for standard printer paper (US Letter / A4). Enabling 'Background graphics' in your print dialog ensures crisp, clear line art.
